justifications.durability: tests/test_iron_field_source.py:229 fails at d65d3dfcd (negative-control.log records the unquoted assignment) and passes at head, but the JSON-validity and per-arm-log fixes of run_arms.sh:98-112 have no regression assertion.
justifications.evidence: baseline_suite-1795358077141044239.log:9 records 8 passed at b62734cd and after_suite-1795358119882990097.log:9 records 9 passed at 65c7f8708, the +1 being the new quoting test collected only at the head.
justifications.fit: scripts/iron_field_source/figure.py:151-176 follows the established figure.legend(... loc="outside upper center", frameon=False) idiom used at scripts/accuracy_cost_ladder/measure.py:828, and every new symbol and comment names a mechanism, not a plan or ticket id.
justifications.goal_fidelity: scripts/iron_field_source/figure.py:44-72,151-176 draws one figure legend above the panels and three phase-offset dash styles, and the rendered PNG at docs/figures/iron-core-magnetisation/icm-iron-field-source/west-62751-iron-stray-field.png shows all three iron curves and no text over data.
justifications.reuse: The added IRON_STYLES constant and log_path helper have no existing owner in nova/media or scripts; the figure-level legend extends the existing script idiom rather than duplicating it.
justifications.scope_discipline: Every one of the six changed paths in the diff is a declared path, and the two PNG copies are byte-identical (md5 e8a2527adc9c1231e476b9f926db592f).
